Ram the Gate

Siege, attacker. Drive the ram home: 2d10+12 concussive structure damage to the current layer, and the garrison reels (defender Anytime budget −1). In the clash: 20 marks off the Buffer.

Queued on the turn: Violence 30 marks. Fired in the clash: 20 marks from the garrison's bank.
